I walked the spec steps for flatMap (ToObject, LengthOfArrayLike, IsCallable check, ArraySpeciesCreate(obj, 0), FlattenIntoArray with depth 1 and the mapper) and for FlattenIntoArray (HasProperty then Get, mapper Call with element, index and source, IsArray only when depth > 0, recursion with newDepth and no mapper, the 2^53-1 TypeError check, CreateDataPropertyOrThrow, targetIndex increment, return targetIndex).
